nodes.summary: The rank of a group $G$ is the supremum, in the natural numbers, of the minimal numbers of generators of the subgroups of $G$, where an unbounded set of natural numbers has supremum $0$. For a finite group $G$ it is the largest minimal number of generators of a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Rank of a group

nodes.summary: Let $\gamma_1(P) = P$ and $\gamma_{i+1}(P) = [\gamma_i(P), P]$ be the lower central series of a group $P$. The group $P$ has cyclic lower central factors from the second on if for every $i \ge 2$ there is an element $g \in \gamma_i(P)$ such that every $x \in \gamma_i(P)$ satisfies $x g^{-k} \in \gamma_{i+1}(P)$ for some integer $k$, that is, the factor $\gamma_i(P)/\gamma_{i+1}(P)$ is cyclic.
nodes.title: Cyclic lower central factors from the second on

nodes.summary: For a subgroup $H$ of a group $G$, the minimal number of generators of $H$ is the least natural number $n$ such that $H$ is generated by some finite set of $n$ elements of $G$; it is $0$ when $H$ is not finitely generated.
nodes.title: Minimal number of generators of a subgroup

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$ and every natural number $r$ there is a finite $p$-group $P$ generated by two elements, whose lower central factors $\gamma_i(P)/\gamma_{i+1}(P)$ are cyclic for all $i \ge 2$, such that for every normal subgroup $N$ of $P$ of nilpotency class at most $2$ the quotient $P/N$ has rank greater than $r$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
